text: It is possible for a man to live in a palace without wanting either guards or embroidered dresses, or torches and statues, and such-like show; but that it is in such a man's power to bring himself very near to the fashion of a private person, without being for this reason either meaner in thought, or more remiss in action.
author: Marcus Aurelius
location: On campaign on the Danube frontier, e.g. Carnuntum or Sirmium (presumed)
